headline: Brewers Climb, Rays Surge
caption:
Milwaukee started the playoffs at 26% to win the World Series in our model. Today it sits at 67%, a 41-point climb and the biggest rise on the chart.

Tampa Bay made the biggest move today, jumping from 11% to 33%. That is up from 10% at the start, and 33% is the highest the Rays have been all postseason.

The biggest fall belongs to the Dodgers: 24% at the start, a peak of 37%, now 0% after elimination. Cleveland peaked at 20% and the Yankees at 17% before going out, and the White Sox topped out at 9%.

Milwaukee is at 67%, Tampa Bay at 33%. Does the model have this right, or do the Rays keep climbing?
